statement: A rolling-restart post-recovery leader-signature reset is classified from preserved all-incarnation evidence as a real Raft transition, observation artifact, or evidence-incomplete event; every real transition names the partition, old and new leader and term, campaign or heartbeat-loss witness, peer cohort, and nearby event-loop context, while restarted-node runtime logs survive incarnation boundaries and quiescence observation adds no polling owner, protocol timer change, or stability-policy change.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Change evidence capture and read-only attribution only. Do not change Raft election, heartbeat, lease, candidacy, pre-vote, quiescence, readiness, recovery, admission, workload, restart ordering, sampling cadence, or timeout behavior.

Reuse full-node-log-capture, the cluster lifecycle restart streamer, incarnation-boundary records, candidateWindowResetHistory, source-fingerprint validation, and existing distributed analyzers. Do not add a log polling owner, topology observer, control-plane query lane, or parallel failure classifier.

A restarted node's one gzip artifact must preserve ordered runtime records from every incarnation, with exactly one explicit boundary per restart, no truncation or overwrite of prior bytes, no duplicate post-boundary records, a valid gzip stream after each close, and source-fingerprint evidence per incarnation.

Each leader-signature reset emits exactly one typed outcome: real_raft_transition only with partition plus old/new leader and term and campaign/heartbeat-loss evidence; observation_artifact only when authoritative Raft state is unchanged and the observer differs; evidence_incomplete otherwise, naming every missing witness. Never infer an election, heartbeat loss, or observer defect from absence.

Attribution consumes already-emitted logs and existing reset history offline. It must not issue an admin query, topology snapshot, retry, timer, or control-plane write, and it must remain valid with debug logs disabled.

A deterministic fixture reproduces the retained 20260802T093326Z shape: the original incarnation log followed by a boundary and currently-missing restarted runtime records, repeated reset signatures on sql_transactions/sql_write_operations/control_plane_publications/schema_operations, and nearby event-loop gaps. Before the fix it reports missing restarted-incarnation evidence; after the fix it attributes real transitions or preserves evidence_incomplete honestly.

Deterministic tests must fail when restart stream reattachment, append semantics, boundary ordering, any required transition witness, or typed incomplete classification is reverted while the prior coarse leadership_unstable result remains available.

Run the existing model-contract gate for adjacency. Do not extend TLA+ or Alloy unless implementation changes protocol, lifecycle, owner cardinality, recovery, or observation scheduling semantics beyond offline evidence projection.

After deterministic closure, exact-source independent verification, and a clean commit, at most one unchanged non-certification N=1 engagement may validate that restarted-node runtime records and typed attribution survive real Docker restart. Do not use it for mechanism discovery, and do not start or contribute to an N=15 certification window.
